settings.title: What we collect
settings.body: Your name, contact details, delivery address and order history. Payment details go to Shopify, not to us.

settings.title: Why we hold it
settings.body: To take payment, send your order, answer questions and meet our tax obligations.

settings.title: Who sees it
settings.body: Shopify, our carrier, and our accountant. Nobody else, and we do not sell data.

settings.title: How long we keep it
settings.body: Order and invoice records for 7 years. Marketing consent for 3 years from last activity. Site analytics for 14 months.

settings.title: Cookies
settings.body: Necessary cookies keep the cart and sign-in working. Analytics and marketing cookies are optional and set only if you allow them.

settings.title: Your rights
settings.body: A copy, a correction, or deletion — email privacy@wearryvt.com and we answer within thirty days.

settings.title: Contact
settings.body: privacy@wearryvt.com, or write to RYVT LLC, Metro Detroit, Michigan.

settings.heading: Privacy Policy
settings.lede: What we collect when you shop with us, why we hold it, how long we keep it, and how to make us delete it.
